audit_notes.prompt_token_usage: Pinned vLLM counts the complete chat-templated prompt, including cached tokens. Cache hits are separate optional prompt_tokens_details; do not subtract them from prompt identity checks.
audit_notes.prompt_template: Pinned Qwen template appends the assistant prefix and an empty think block for enable_thinking=False. Diagnostic prompt-ID hashes check tokenization; absence of structured reasoning alone is not a semantic proof when no parser is enabled.
audit_notes.streaming: SSE receipt chunks may contain multiple tokens or metadata only. TTFT uses first nonempty content. TPOT is a stream-boundary estimate, not measured individual-token latency.
audit_notes.numerical_scope: Smoke verifies returned prompt/output token identities and finite selected-token API logprobs. Equal text alone is weaker. After a generated-token divergence, logprobs have different conditioning. Temperature 0 and finite selected-token logprobs do not prove all-layer numerical, routing or committed-weight consistency.
audit_notes.logprob_limits: Pinned vLLM can clamp unavailable/extreme logprobs to -9999; the client reports these separately. Top-logprobs0 does not expose runner-up margins or all logits.
audit_notes.eplb: Native async launch logs do not report successful layer/final commits or map versions. A later launch is only conditional evidence that prior work ceased pending; the last cycle remains unverified. drain_async acknowledges but discards transferred weights.
audit_notes.opportunities: Native counter starts at 2250 for interval 3000. Dummy DP steps increment it, and pending async work may defer launches. Request/output-token totals cannot recover exact opportunity counts. Balancedness logging adds collective/synchronization overhead and is not enabled merely for this report.
audit_notes.metrics: Native histogram deltas retain exact engine/model labels. Request RUNNING time is not GPU kernel service. Snapshot publication can lag completion; absent or decreasing series are unavailable, not zero. No EPLB commit metric is present in the audited metrics source.
